retrievalProfile.description: A stark, two-panel layout featuring a black header with white high-contrast serifs above a saturated red-and-black duotone photograph framed in white.
triggerTerms: black header with white serif text
excludeWhen: soft or pastel color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition divided into a solid black upper third containing centered white typography and a lower two-thirds featuring a high-contrast red duotone image of a group, enclosed in a thin white border.
coreVisualRelationships: Black header vs. vibrant red image field
White serif typography vs. solid black background
Thin white frame vs. saturated duotone content
Centered text alignment vs. horizontal group arrangement
coreInvariants: Pure black background for the top section
Saturated red and black duotone effect on the photograph
Thin white rectangular border around the image area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group subject is centered in the lower frame, scaled to fill the width with heads near the top of the red field.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The centered white typography in the black header acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the bold text to the high-contrast red image below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant solid black negative space in the upper third provides breathing room for the title.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (mid-tones and highlights of the image)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast with no gradients; colors are either fully saturated or solid black/white.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Overlapping characters in the main title to create a unified block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use a smaller version of the same high-contrast serif for subtitles to maintain stylistic unity.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and vertical stress of the era.
Provides the elegant hair-line serifs and thick stems.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical layout with a solid black top section and a lower section containing a high-contrast red and black duotone photo of a group, framed by a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Center-align white text in a high-contrast Modern Serif font (like Bodoni) in the black header area.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly red and black duotone?
Is the text centered in the black header?
Is there a thin white border around the red image area?

adjustableVariables: Vertical ratio of black header to red image
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones exist in the duotone area.
Verify the white border is perfectly rectangular.
Check that the serif font has hair-line thin strokes.
Confirm the layout is split into distinct black and red zones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid black header + High-contrast white serif text + Red/Black duotone image + White keyline frame.
